# Assets · Icons

109 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for share-2.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Lucide icons (ISC licence, lucide-static 1.53.0) used by SongNodes, one meaning each (see the Identity and iconography section). The files are drawn with a neutral grey stroke `#8a8a8a` (an `<img>` can't inherit colour); in code use `SongNodes.icon(name)` or `lucide-react`, which inherit `currentColor`. 2px stroke, 24px grid, shown at 16, 18, 20 or 24px.
